postgresAclBlocker.finding: Selected Postgres repository methods issue direct table SQL, while target proposal roles revoke table access and grant only SECURITY DEFINER function execution.
postgresAclBlocker.requiredRemediation: Add surgical feature-gated Postgres adapters for the approved functions and prove them in isolated disposable PostgreSQL 17 databases under execute-only roles.

limitations: Bot handlers were not imported or executed; bot coupling remains structurally checked and review ownership is exercised through the candidate SQLite store.

No disposable PostgreSQL candidate execution was attempted because static code plus ACL proposals already prove direct-table incompatibility.

rollback: Not applicable; only checkout, tests and evidence changed.
